products.tagline: Upgrade any moisturizer. Transform your skin.
products.hero_desc: A brightening booster serum — add 2-5 drops to your favorite moisturizer and transform it into a powerful brightening cream. No routine change needed.
products.benefits_desc: A science-backed formula with three powerhouse actives — gentle enough for daily use on all skin types
products.benefit1_desc: Tranexamic Acid 3% targets pigmentation at the source, synergizing with Niacinamide 4% to visibly even out skin tone.
products.benefit2_desc: Alpha Arbutin 2% gently inhibits melanin production for a gradual, natural brightening effect visible from week two.
products.benefit3_desc: No need to change your routine. Just add 2-5 drops to your favorite cream, mix in your palm, and apply as usual.
products.routine_desc: Answer 3 quick questions and get a routine tailored just for your skin
products.q2_title: What is your main skin concern?
products.q3_title: When do you prefer to apply your routine?
products.review1_text: I added it to my daily moisturizer and after two weeks noticed a clear difference in the dark spots on my knees and elbows. Super lightweight and didn't change my cream's texture. Already on my second bottle!
products.review2_text: Such a smart concept — I didn't have to switch my favorite moisturizer, I just added the serum. By week two my skin tone was noticeably more even and glowy. Highly recommend.
products.review3_text: I have sensitive skin and can't use many products. This serum is so gentle and caused zero irritation. I noticed an improvement in my skin tone from the very first week. Excellent!
products.cta_eyebrow: The First Step Toward Your Dream Skin
products.cta_desc: The only brightening booster serum that mixes into any moisturizer — powered by Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide & Alpha Arbutin for visible results in 14 days.
